No payment is taken until you approve the plan. Common questions

Teams excavate, record and interpret a prepared trench, then present their reading of the evidence. The exercise rewards careful observation and clear reporting rather than speed.

All materials are provided. The session is adapted to your space, your timetable and the age of the participants.

What it covers

  • Teams excavate a prepared trench
  • They record their finds as they go
  • Each team presents its reading of the evidence
  • Careful observation and clear reporting win, not speed

How the time is spent

  1. Brief and roles 35 min

    Assign supervisor, recorder, analyst roles.

    You: team plan

  2. Challenge 110 min

    Mock find documentation in time.

    You: complete records

  3. Presentation 35 min

    Justify timeline with evidence.

    You: poster review

Timings are a guide. The plan is confirmed with your quotation.

By the end you can

  • Work as a team in assigned roles of supervisor, recorder and analyst.
  • Record finds accurately as you excavate a prepared trench.
  • Present a reading of the evidence and justify your timeline with it.

You take away

An activity sheet to keep.
